= TensorFlow Serving
:artifactid: camel-tensorflow-serving-starter

Run inference on the models of a TensorFlow Serving model server over gRPC, and get their status and metadata.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::tensorflow-serving-component.adoc[TensorFlow Serving component], URI syntax: `tensorflow-serving:api`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-tensorflow-serving-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----

== Spring Boot Auto-Configuration

The starter supports 10 options, which are listed below.

[width="100%",cols="2,5,^1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Name | Description | Default | Type
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.autowired-enabled | Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc. | true | Boolean
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.configuration | The configuration that the endpoints start from. Each endpoint gets a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint replace its values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.tensorflow.serving.TensorFlowServingConfiguration type. |  | TensorFlowServingConfiguration
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.credentials | The io.grpc.ChannelCredentials of the gRPC channel, for example a TlsChannelCredentials for TLS, given as a bean reference. If not set, InsecureChannelCredentials is used, and the calls are sent in plaintext. The option is a io.grpc.ChannelCredentials type. |  | ChannelCredentials
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.enabled | Whether to enable auto configuration of the tensorflow-serving component. This is enabled by default. |  | Boolean
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.lazy-start-producer | Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing. | false | Boolean
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.model-name | The name of the model (servable) to call. The CamelTensorFlowServingModelName header replaces this option, and the model_spec of a request in the body replaces both. The option or the header must be set, even when the request in the body names the model. |  | String
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.model-version | The version number of the model to use. If no version and no version label is set, the server uses the best available version, typically the latest. The CamelTensorFlowServingModelVersion header replaces this option, and a version label, if one is set, is used instead of it. |  | Long
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.model-version-label | The label of the model version to use, as assigned by version_labels in the model server configuration, for example stable or canary. The CamelTensorFlowServingModelVersionLabel header replaces this option. A version label is used instead of a version number. |  | String
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.signature-name | The name of the signature (SignatureDef) of the model to evaluate, for classify, regress and predict. If not set, the server uses the default signature, serving_default. The CamelTensorFlowServingSignatureName header replaces this option. |  | String
| camel.component.tensorflow-serving.target | The target of the gRPC channel to the model server, as host:port or as a gRPC target URI such as dns:///host:8500. The default is the gRPC port of TensorFlow Serving on the local host. The channel is created once, when the endpoint is initialized. | localhost:8500 | String
